generate_tests: generate tests by mixing in a concrete RPC agent fixture with generic test suites to autogenerate combined test classes
run_rpc_tests: run distributed RPC tests across multiple agents including TensorPipe, ProcessGroup, and faulty agent fixtures
test_cuda_rpc: test CUDA-enabled RPC functionality using specialized CUDA test suites for remote modules and dist autograd
test_faulty_agent: test fault injection and error handling behavior using the faulty RPC agent test suites
spawn_test_processes: spawn multiprocessing test processes with TCP init setup and teardown for distributed RPC testing
